controls.context: fresh-per-run; same task, grants, sources and tools across arms
controls.budgetScope: whole episode including all members, retries, routing, coordination and failed calls

prompts.common: Complete the supplied task using only its authorized fixture resources. Role and WorkMode never grant authority. Preserve source/goal versions, receipts and audience. Return the deliverable to the source thread; remain silent when no action is warranted. Report uncertainty and blocked actions honestly.
prompts.workflow: Identify the deliverable and acceptance criteria; inspect authorized evidence; separate facts from assumptions; perform the domain procedure: {procedure}; verify the result and cite evidence IDs; report limitations. For collaboration, split complementary work only when useful, preserve source and goal versions in handoffs, reconcile receipts, and stop duplicate or circular work.
